line.name: JFR Lunatic Habano
line.description: The Habano-wrapper branch of JFR's long-running 'Lunatic' line, added 2016 under Casa Fernandez.
line.factory: Tabacos Valle de Jalapa S.A. (TABSA), Esteli, Nicaragua (per 2016-era sourcing; current factory attribution may have shifted to Aganorsa facilities along with the rest of the brand - not independently confirmed for this specific sub-line).

vitolas.name: Lunatic (8x80)
vitolas.notes: Matches the Mac photo. The original belicoso-style size sometimes just listed as 'Lunatic.'

research_notes: 2 additional Mac photos ('JFR_Luna-Hab-Rob' and 'JFR_Luna-Hab-Short') could not be confidently matched to a single confirmed vitola name - both a 'Short Robusto' (4.25x52) and a 'Short Titan' (4.25-4.75x60) exist for this line, and 'Rob'/'Short' alone don't disambiguate with certainty. Not added as confirmed vitolas - see _jfr-UNRESOLVED.json.
